title: Determination of sulfonamide antibiotics in forage grasses by an improved QuEChERS and multi-plug filtration cleanup method combined with UHPLC-MS/MS
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34261-34269
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04330H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Min Xie, Jun Xu, Dan Fei, Ye-Lan Guang, Yao-Min Zhou, Fan Li, Li-Zhen Hu
An improved QuEChERS method combined with Multi-Plug Filtration Cleanup clean-up procedure was developed for the simultaneous determination of 16 different sulfonamides in forage grass using UHPLC-MS/MS.
